entries.name: Universitätsklinik für Kleintiere — Vetmeduni Vienna (Tierspital)
entries.address: Veterinärplatz 1, 1210 Wien (Gebäude KC; outside opening hours ring at the clinic main entrance)
entries.duty: 24h-Notdienst on +43 1 25077-5555 (please phone ahead); life-threatening cases may come without notice to the central emergency admission. Regular: Mon/Wed/Fri 8-16, Tue/Thu 9.30-16, appointments +43 1 25077-4444
entries.quote: rund um die Uhr an allen Tagen des Jahres für Sie erreichbar
entries.note: University small-animal hospital. Referral PDF notes an emergency surcharge and an on-site deposit.

entries.name: AniCura Tierklinik Erdberg
entries.duty: Emergency 00-24 every day; appointments weekdays 9-19
entries.quote: Wir sind 24 Stunden am Tag, 365 Tage im Jahr erreichbar.
entries.note: Contact page also prints an emergency line '+43 1361 81 67 10' (format as printed); AniCura emergency-clinic list gives +43 1 361 81 670.

entries.name: Vetklinikum
entries.duty: Notambulanz Mon-Sun 0:00-24:00, no phone pre-registration needed, triage; consultations Mon-Fri 9-18
entries.quote: Unsere Notambulanz steht Ihnen 24/7, an 365 Tagen im Jahr, zur Verfügung.
entries.note: Dogs and cats only (no reptiles, birds or exotics). Emergency surcharge.

entries.name: Tierklinik Döbling
entries.duty: 24h emergency service by phone; the on-call vet may not be at the clinic, so always call ahead. Regular: Mon-Fri 9-19 (appointments from 14:00), Sat 9-13
entries.quote: 24h Notdienst
entries.note: Phone on-call service; no house calls in emergencies.

entries.quote: Die Tierklinik Mauer ist rund um die Uhr für Notfälle erreichbar
entries.note: 24h is an on-call (Rufbereitschaft) phone service. The clinic's own Jimdo site (kasernprobe2.jimdoweb.com) shows the same numbers and 'RUND-UM-DIE-UHR (Tag und Nacht)'.

notes: Covered all 9 Bundesländer: 24-h clinics in Wien (Vetmeduni, AniCura Erdberg, Vetklinikum, Döbling and Mauer on-call), NÖ (Hollabrunn, St. Pölten, Perchtoldsdorf, Dobersberg; Pegasus horses only), Burgenland (Parndorf, Neusiedl on-call), OÖ (Schwanenstadt, Sattledt, Wels, Steyr), Steiermark (Thalerhof, Muttendorf, Leoben), Vorarlberg (Cepicka phone 24h), Tirol (only a practice's 24h phone line). Duty rotas: Salzburg Kleintiernotruf + Innergebirge rota, Graz, Linz, Kärnten weekend duty, Innsbruck weekday-night line. No official small-animal rota found for Wien, NÖ, Burgenland, Vorarlberg (only farm animals) or Tirol-wide (pages blocked). No 24-h clinic in Kärnten (ORF Kärnten 10.02.2026) or Salzburg. Poison line: VIZ (01 406 43 43) does not say it advises on animal poisonings, so no poison_line entry. Not reachable / left: tieraerztekammer.at landing + Landesstellen pages, meintierdoktor.at (redirect blocked), tirol.gv.at Wochenenddienste/Sonntagsdienst pages and tierarzt-notdienst.tirol (blocked), Salzburg Q4 2026 PDFs, tierklinik-gilli.at (Bruck/Mur), tierklinik-erdmann.at (Klagenfurt, on the Kärnten rota), tierklinik-hainburg.at, tierklinik-seekirchen.at, tierklinik-planner.at (Dornbirn), badischl.vet (Tierklinik Bad Ischl, redirect loop; only a tourism listing), buchner-vet.at. Tourist areas still thin: St. Anton/Landeck, Ischgl/Paznaun, Sölden (only Tierklinik Imst nearby), Mayrhofen (Zell am Ziller only), Zell am See/Bad Gastein (Bruck rota practice only), Velden, Salzkammergut; more Graz, Salzburg-city, Innsbruck and Vorarlberg (Dornbirn/Feldkirch) practices could be added in a follow-up run.
